title: MLINE LTYPE XDATA code-1005 TEXT targets with a STYLE dependency

scope.source: Runtime-generated ASCII/binary DXF records; no repository drawing fixture was added.
scope.cross_product: One selected plain TEXT profile was exercised for all four ASCII/binary source and output combinations in each of two source sections.
scope.linetype: EditDash with two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0 and alignment 65.
scope.xdata: One source-bound APPID, one group-1000 payload, then one ordered group-1005 soft pointer.

proof.source: The physical LTYPE XDATA sequence is bound to its APPID. Each target is uniquely identified by source handle, source section, block-record owner, parsed callback and exact DRW_Text dynamic type. The source TEXT's named STYLE dependency is separately source-bound and contains non-default width, oblique angle, last height and font fields.
proof.output: For both source sections and all four encoding pairs, emitted physical XDATA is checked against the remapped TEXT handle. The model-space target is emitted in ENTITIES under *Model_Space; the named target remains in BLOCKS under AuthorityBlock. Physical output and fresh typed readback verify target owner, insertion/alignment points, text value, height, rotation, width factor, oblique angle, generation/alignment flags, style name and the emitted STYLE row joined by the target's group-7 name.
proof.failure_retry: For each section and encoding pair, removing the TEXT target refuses export and preserves the prior destination; restoring it permits same-adapter retry. Separate late-mutation probes change the target handle after APPID emission in ENTITIES and BLOCKS; finalization refuses without replacing the destination, and restoring the original handle permits same-adapter retry with physical output and typed readback.

focused_ctest.result: PASS (1/1, 16.82 seconds); selector asserts whole-test counts listed above

validation.asan: NOT_RUN; this slice adds bounded entity target routing and generated proof, with no ownership-transfer change. Revisit at the planned sanitizer checkpoint.

limits: This qualifies one AC1027 plain TEXT target in model-space ENTITIES and one in named AuthorityBlock BLOCKS, each with one ordered code-1005 XDATA reference and one named STYLE dependency. It does not qualify other TEXT profiles, ATTRIB/ATTDEF/MTEXT/RTEXT/ARCALIGNEDTEXT, other target entity types, larger reference counts, versions or application meanings.

This is selected transport, source identity, STYLE-name dependency, output, typed readback and transaction evidence only; it does not establish text rendering, font availability, annotation meaning, recursive document closure or format support claims.
